color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim. Light register confirmed: pageBackground #f5f2ee, luminance 242.4. Candidates scanned: formless-ai (dark, lum 0), buttermax (dark, lum 0), teenage-engineering (light, lum 229), pedro-kalk (light, lum 242), linen-verge (light, lum 255), gemnote (light, lum 242.4) — selected gemnote for its warm linen palette and full nav color token set.

type-system.twistDescription: Letter-spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em) applied to headings and all uppercase elements. Buttermax's proprietary 'my Font' replaced with Barlow Condensed (Google Fonts CDN, weights 500;600;700) via get-fallback-font logic — condensed editorial sans matching compact uppercase register. No woff2 references in CSS output.

fontSubstitution.reason: Condensed editorial sans — matches compact uppercase register of source system. Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Easing curve swap: primary easing changed from ease-in to ease-in-out (Material Standard cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) added as secondary). Creates bilateral symmetry in all transitions — elements decelerate as smoothly as they accelerate. Complements the measured editorial voice of the type system.

grid-system.twistDescription: Container max-width tightened 15% from 1280px to 1088px. More editorial column proportions resist wide-monitor sprawl. All grid template column values proportionally scaled down. Adds magazine-like focus to the layout.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Section breathing room: section paddingTop increased 40→72px (+32px), paddingBottom 22→54px (+32px), footer paddingTop 40→72px. All other spacing values unchanged from linen-verge source. Atmospheric separation between content blocks matches the system's editorial pace.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover opacity twist: opacity 0.75 added to hover states for links, cards, and navigation items. Elements quietly recede on hover rather than aggressively transforming — harmonically matched to the warm linen background. Transition duration 0.3s maintained from source.

nav-system.twistDescription: Letter spacing on nav links: 0.08em added to nav typography (intensity 3). Nav links read as catalog index entries — tracked uppercase creates horizontal tension appropriate to the condensed editorial register of the full type system. fontFamily: inherit ensures nav uses the system primary font.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift applied to Section 5 (Background and Section Design Behavior). Added specific tactile language: 'weight of unbleached fiber', 'endpaper of a well-made book', 'cotton-rag print'. Generated concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements: hero-texture.mp4 (macro linen weave drift, 10s), process-ambient.mp4 (hands working, 8s), material-field.mp4 (overhead flat lay slow zoom, 10s). Also added 'What Resists Categorization' closing section.

navText_vs_navBackground.note: Dark text on light background — sufficient contrast

bodyText_vs_pageBackground.note: Dark text on light background — sufficient contrast

checkB_motionInteractionCoherence.note: Hover at 0.3s vs motion primary at 0.2s — ratio 1.5x, well within 5x threshold

checkC_navFontAvailability.note: nav.json uses fontFamily: inherit — resolved to system primary font (Barlow Condensed)
